items.title: The Forgotten Password
items.premise: Setup: Customer sits across from Clerk at a bank desk. Clerk asks, 'What is your security question?' Customer says, 'Your childhood best friend's name.' Clerk asks, 'And what is the answer?' Punchline: Customer flatly replies, 'I had no friends.' Clerk: 'Access granted. Welcome back.' Reaction beat: Both stare blankly at the screen in silence.

items.title: The Silent Stare
items.premise: Setup: Doctor taps patient's knee in a quiet examination room. Doctor asks, 'Does it hurt when I press here?' Patient says, 'No.' Doctor asks, 'How about here?' Patient says, 'No.' Punchline: Doctor says, 'Good. My thumb was asleep.' Reaction beat: Doctor slowly wiggles thumb while Patient stares motionless.

items.title: The Airport Scan
items.premise: Setup: Passenger steps up to Airport Guard at security scanner. Guard says, 'Sir, step aside please.' Passenger asks, 'Is there a problem?' Guard says, 'The scanner shows zero brain activity.' Punchline: Passenger replies, 'I was thinking about soup.' Guard nods: 'My mistake. Move along.' Reaction beat: Guard signals him through silently.

items.title: The Fake Noodles
items.premise: Setup: Dad walks into the living room smiling brightly at Teen. Dad asks, 'Hey kid, what do you call a fake noodle?' Teen sighs in defeat, 'I don't know, Dad, what?' Punchline: Dad beams, 'An impasta!' Reaction beat: Dad bursts into loud belly laughter while Teen buries face in a couch pillow with a heavy groan.

items.title: The Roof Story
items.premise: Setup: Dad comes up to Teen working on homework. Dad asks, 'Did you hear about the guy who invented the knock-knock joke?' Teen says, 'No, who?' Punchline: Dad slaps his knee, 'He won a no-bell prize!' Reaction beat: Dad laughs hysterically at his own joke while Teen glares in utter disappointment.

items.title: The Bicycle Problem
items.premise: Setup: Pun Master approaches Sidekick in a park. Pun Master asks, 'Why couldn't the bicycle stand up by itself?' Sidekick rolls eyes and asks, 'Why?' Punchline: Pun Master exclaims, 'Because it was two-tired!' Reaction beat: A cartoon rimshot plays while Sidekick slowly shakes head in disbelief.

items.title: The Cheesy Love
items.premise: Setup: Pun Master holds up a wedge of cheddar cheese to Sidekick. Pun Master asks, 'What did the cheese say when it looked in the mirror?' Sidekick asks, 'What?' Punchline: Pun Master grins, 'Halloumi-nating! You look gouda today!' Reaction beat: Sidekick slowly facepalms while Pun Master winks at the camera.

items.title: The Walking Path Decision
items.premise: Setup: POV walking down an empty sidewalk when someone walks toward you from afar. Me thinks: 'Do I look left? Look at my phone? Smile?' Inner Voice commands: 'Initiate manual walking mode.' Punchline: Me suddenly forgets how arms work and walks stiffly like a wooden robot. Reaction beat: Me turns around, deeply embarrassed.

items.title: The Lower the Volume
items.premise: Setup: POV driving into a tight parallel parking spot with upbeat music playing. Me turns the car radio volume all the way down to zero. Inner Voice asks: 'Why are you turning down the music?' Punchline: Me says seriously, 'Because I can't see the parking space!' Reaction beat: Me squints intensely out the window in dead silence.

items.title: What Has Hands But Can't Clap
items.premise: Setup: Riddler asks Contestant, 'Riddle me this! What has hands, but can't clap, and faces you every morning?' Contestant thinks deeply, 'Is it a mirror?' Punchline: Riddler grins, 'A clock! But also your disappointed alarm clock!' Reaction beat: Contestant stares silently as a ticking clock sound plays.

items.title: The Wet Towel
items.premise: Setup: Riddler asks Contestant, 'What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?' Contestant guesses nervously, 'Is it... rain?' Punchline: Riddler shouts, 'A towel! But mentally... your brain during exam week!' Reaction beat: Contestant slowly nods in solemn agreement.

items.title: The Quick Status Update
items.premise: Setup: Boss walks up to Employee's desk. Boss asks, 'How is that quarterly project report coming along?' Employee looks at a completely blank screen. Punchline: Employee says calmly, 'It's currently in the conceptual stage.' Boss asks, 'What does that mean?' Employee: 'I'm thinking about starting it.' Reaction beat: Boss stares blankly while Employee slowly sips coffee.

items.title: The Silent Camera Off
items.premise: Setup: Teacher announces during online class, 'Alright everyone, please turn your cameras on!' Student is in pajamas eating crunchy cereal with messy bedhead. Student types in chat: 'My camera is broken today!' Punchline: Teacher sighs over the speaker, 'Alex, I can literally hear your cereal crunching.' Reaction beat: Student freezes mid-bite with spoon in mouth.

items.title: The Silent Walking Aura
items.premise: Setup: Friend sees Trend Setter walking at a incredibly slow pace down the hallway. Friend asks, 'Why are you walking so slowly with high aura?' Punchline: Trend Setter stops, adjusts dark sunglasses in slow motion and says, 'I'm not slow. I'm maintaining my low-energy aesthetic.' Reaction beat: Friend squints in confusion while Trend Setter glides away silently.

items.title: The Main Character Soundtrack
items.premise: Setup: Friend watches Trend Setter carefully put on noise-canceling headphones just to walk ten feet across the kitchen. Friend asks, 'Why do you need headphones to walk to the microwave?' Punchline: Trend Setter replies dramatically, 'Every cinematic quest requires a background soundtrack.' Friend: 'It's leftover soup.' Reaction beat: Trend Setter gazes heroically into the spinning microwave as epic music swells.
